title: ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks
summary: Alex Krizhevsky, Ilya Sutskever and Geoffrey E. Hinton published ImageNet Classification with Deep Convolutional Neural Networks in the 2012 Neural Information Processing Systems proceedings, reporting a large deep convolutional neural network trained for ImageNet classification and substantially lower test error than the comparison results described in the paper.
significance: A documented 2012 deep-convolutional-network milestone in large-scale image classification, with the original proceedings record describing the model architecture, GPU implementation and ImageNet results.

verification.note: Title, authors, 2012 proceedings placement, deep convolutional architecture, ImageNet training context and reported test-error comparison are verified against the official NeurIPS proceedings record. The authors' University of Toronto-hosted paper independently corroborates the author affiliations, architecture, GPU implementation, dropout use and ILSVRC-2012 result. The candidate is intentionally stored at year precision because the checked primary sources establish 2012 but do not establish a publication day appropriate for the event boundary. University of Toronto is recorded only as the explicitly stated author affiliation; no broader geography, ancestry, influence, causality or relationship claim is inferred.
